input.command:
cd $STACK_WORKDIR/scratch/octmp.noindex/oc-ledger/ledger && python3 - <<'EOF'
s = "01/01/2015 | Buy present               |      (€10.00)"
# split on " | "
parts = s.split(" | ")
ch = parts[2]
print("change field repr:", repr(ch))
print("change field bytes:", len(ch.encode('utf-8')))
print("change field runes:", len(ch))
# count leading spaces
import re
m = re.match(r'^( *)', ch)
print("leading spaces:", len(m.group(1)))
print("after spaces bytes:", len(m.group(1).encode())+len(ch[len(m.group(1)):].encode()))
EOF
